author: swiggy
title: Diwali food delivery discount
body: Swiggy is offering flat 5% off on all delivery orders above Rs 300 during Diwali week (Oct 28 - Nov 3).
note: The example from the brief. Bajaj Auto must not be notified.

author: bajaj-auto
title: Chetak electric scooter festive bookings open
body: Bookings for the new Chetak electric scooter are open across 3,000 dealerships, with deliveries from Dhanteras. We are looking for financing partners to offer low-cost EMIs and for insurers to issue cover at the showroom.

author: hdfc-bank
title: Festive card offers for merchants
body: HDFC Bank is funding a 10% instant discount on credit cards for online shopping, flight and hotel bookings and electronics this festive season. E-commerce and travel merchants can join the programme.

author: phonepe
title: UPI Lite limit raised
body: NPCI has raised the UPI Lite per-transaction limit to Rs 1,000. PhonePe users can now make small payments faster at merchants without entering a PIN.

author: tata-power
title: Fast charging network reaches 500 cities
body: Tata Power EZ Charge now runs fast charging stations for electric two-wheelers and cars in 500 cities, with fleet plans for delivery operators.

author: airtel
title: Cricket season prepaid plan
body: Airtel launches a Rs 449 prepaid plan with unlimited 5G data and a free OTT streaming subscription for the cricket season.

author: makemytrip
title: Winter holiday flight and hotel sale
body: Up to 20% off domestic flights and hotels for the December holidays. Looking for bank and card partners to add instant discounts, and for an insurer to add trip cover.

author: flipkart
title: Big Billion Days dates announced
body: Big Billion Days runs Sept 27 - Oct 4 with deep discounts on smartphones, TVs and fashion. Bank partners and payment providers can apply for checkout offers.

author: zepto
title: 10-minute grocery delivery in 15 new cities
body: Zepto is launching 10-minute grocery delivery in 15 new cities with 200 new dark stores. We are hiring delivery partners and looking for electric scooter fleet and charging partners.

author: acko
title: Embed motor insurance at the point of sale
body: Acko now offers instant motor insurance that dealers and vehicle makers can embed at checkout with a single API call.

author: hdfc-bank
title: Repo rate unchanged, vehicle loan rates steady
body: After RBI kept the repo rate at 6.5%, HDFC Bank is holding its two-wheeler and car loan interest rates through the festive season.

author: swiggy
title: Swiggy is moving 30% of its delivery fleet to electric
body: Swiggy will move 30% of delivery partner trips to electric scooters by March and is looking for vehicle and charging partners.

author: phonepe
title: Scam alert: fake Diwali cashback links
body: Fraudsters are sending fake 'Diwali cashback' links that ask users to enter their UPI PIN. PhonePe will never ask for a PIN to receive money.

author: bajaj-auto
title: Two-wheeler sales up 18% in October
body: Bajaj Auto's domestic two-wheeler sales grew 18% year on year in October, led by festive demand in tier-2 towns.

author: airtel
title: Scheduled network maintenance in Mumbai
body: Airtel will carry out scheduled maintenance in parts of Mumbai on Sunday between 2 and 5 AM. Some customers may see brief service disruption.

author: flipkart
title: Electric delivery vans for the festive peak
body: Flipkart needs extra last-mile delivery capacity in 40 cities for the festive peak and wants to add electric vans and three-wheelers to its fleet.

author: makemytrip
title: Travel insurance on every international booking
body: MakeMyTrip will include travel insurance with every international flight booking from next month and is choosing an insurance partner.

author: tata-power
title: Rooftop solar on zero-cost EMI
body: Tata Power rooftop solar is now available on 0% EMI. We are looking for bank partners to finance installations for homeowners.

author: zepto
title: Zepto Pass: free delivery above Rs 99
body: Zepto Pass members get free delivery on grocery orders above Rs 99 and extra discounts on fruits and vegetables.
note: HDFC's profile lists e-commerce, food delivery, travel and electronics but not grocery, so it is ok rather than must.

author: airtel
title: Free OTT with smartphones bought on Flipkart
body: Airtel customers who buy a 5G smartphone on Flipkart get six months of a free OTT subscription.

author: phonepe
title: Rs 100 cashback on first flight booking via UPI
body: PhonePe is giving Rs 100 cashback on the first flight booking paid with UPI on any travel app.

author: hdfc-bank
title: Pre-approved two-wheeler loans in 10 seconds
body: HDFC Bank customers can now get pre-approved two-wheeler loans instantly at dealerships, with zero processing fee this month.

author: acko
title: Free device protection on smartphones this Diwali
body: Acko is giving free one-year device protection on smartphones bought online during Diwali sales.

author: swiggy
title: New restaurant partner onboarding flow
body: Swiggy has simplified restaurant partner onboarding: restaurants can now list their menu and go live in 24 hours.
